name: Java CI

on: [push, pull_request]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [21]
      fail-fast: false
        
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - uses: actions/cache@v5
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ubuntu-latest-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ubuntu-latest-maven-
    - name: Set up JDK 21
      uses: actions/setup-java@v5
      with:
        distribution: 'temurin'
        java-version: 21
    - name: Build with Maven
      run: ./mvnw -V --file pom.xml --no-transfer-progress -DtrimStackTrace=false -Djunit.jupiter.execution.parallel.enabled=false -P-use-toolchains,docker

name: Java CI

on: [push, pull_request]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [21]
      fail-fast: false
        
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - uses: actions/cache@v5
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ubuntu-latest-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ubuntu-latest-maven-

        java-version: 21
